tv-shows.title: Marianne
tv-shows.description: When a successful horror novelist returns to her hometown, the terrifying woman from her books seems to have stepped into the real world. As people close to her are drawn into the nightmare, she must confront the origin of a presence she thought existed only on the page.

tv-shows.title: Archive 81
tv-shows.description: An archivist is hired to restore a collection of damaged videotapes made by a documentary filmmaker. What starts as a painstaking restoration becomes an obsession with the filmmaker's disappearance, a mysterious apartment building and a story that seems to reach across time.

tv-shows.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
tv-shows.description: The powerful Usher family built its empire on wealth, influence and carefully guarded secrets. When members of the dynasty begin dying in increasingly disturbing circumstances, old bargains and buried wrongdoing threaten to destroy everything the family has protected.

tv-shows.title: The Haunting of Bly Manor
tv-shows.description: A young au pair arrives at a secluded English country estate to care for two orphaned children. The house is filled with quiet grief, unsettling behaviour and memories that refuse to fade, as its troubled past slowly becomes impossible to ignore.

tv-shows.title: Kingdom
tv-shows.description: In a kingdom gripped by political turmoil, a crown prince investigates a mysterious sickness spreading through the countryside. The dead are rising and the living are turning against one another, forcing him to fight both a relentless plague and dangerous rivals.

tv-shows.title: Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities
tv-shows.description: Eight stand-alone tales explore different corners of horror, from ominous objects and secret obsessions to things that should have stayed hidden. Each episode brings a different filmmaker's vision, making the collection a journey through gothic, supernatural and psychological dread.

tv-shows.title: Yellowjackets
tv-shows.description: After a plane crash strands a teenage football team deep in the wilderness, the survivors are forced into desperate choices. Years later, those who made it home are still haunted by what happened, and secrets from their ordeal begin to threaten the lives they rebuilt.

tv-shows.title: Evil
tv-shows.description: A sceptical psychologist joins a priest-in-training and a technical expert to investigate alleged miracles, hauntings and demonic possessions. Their work blurs the boundary between psychology, faith and the unexplained, leaving even the most rational explanations under strain.
